definitions.explanation: the process by which plants convert light energy, water, and carbon dioxide into glucose and oxygen

{光合成|こうごうせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{太陽|たいよう}→太陽：03398_taiyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{光|ひかり}→光：01707_hikari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
